jurisdictions.notes: Temporary Resident Visa (visitor) via IRCC at rules+checklist depth; IRCC secure account login-walled. eTA-vs-TRV split load-bearing: visa-exempt fliers need an eTA (not TRV); visa-exempt land/sea entrants need neither; US citizens/green-card holders are eTA-exempt. TRV fees CAD 100 individual / 500 family(5+), biometrics 85 / 170 family cap. Super Visa requires 100000 medical insurance (health/hospitalization/repatriation, valid 1yr) + host LICO income; mandatory medical exam. Temporary Ebola measures currently affect specified residence and recent-travel routes through 2026-08-28; recheck before travel. Biometrics reuse wording, visa photo dimensions, and the current LICO table remain application-time checks.

jurisdictions.notes: Short-Term Stay (Temporary Visitor). Three branches: (1) visa exemption for 74 countries/regions per MOFA novisa page (Sept 1 2025) - resolve live per nationality; per-country stay 15/30/90 days. (2) JAPAN eVISA - single-entry, tourism-only, ordinary passport, up to 90 days, eligible residences only; direct-online for AU/BR/KH/CA/SA/ZA/TW/UK/US, agency-mediated for CN/PH/VN + HK/IN/ID/MO/MN/KR/SG/AE; electronic issuance, display Visa Issuance Notice QR live at boarding (no PDF/screenshot). (3) Consular short-term visa via responsible mission or accredited agency/JVAC; China (all purposes) and PH/VN packaged tours are accredited-agency-only. Photo 45x35mm. For applications accepted on or after 2026-07-01, MOFA gives approximate standard fees of JPY 15000 single-entry and JPY 30000 multiple-entry, subject to local-currency conversion, nationality, purpose, reciprocal waivers, and agency charges. Processing min 5 working days. Verified live mofa.go.jp 2026-08-03.
